2026-10-23IRCC, PSImmigration and Refugee Protection ActRegulations Amending the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations (Asylum System Reform) Regulations Amending the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations (Asylum System Reform) in order to (1) reduce duplication by simplifying the online application process; (2) establish a time limit for Minister’s due diligence activities; (3) prescribe requirements regarding abandonment of claims /reinstatement of withdrawn claims; (4) set when designated representatives must be appointed; (5) provide quicker access to work permits for asylum seekers; and (6) create two exceptions to the new ineligibility provisions.Registration: SOR/2026-0218 Publication Date: 2026-11-04
subject: Regulations Amending the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations (Asylum System Reform)
precis: Regulations Amending the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations (Asylum System Reform) in order to (1) reduce duplication by simplifying the online application process; (2) establish a time limit for Minister’s due diligence activities; (3) prescribe requirements regarding abandonment of claims /reinstatement of withdrawn claims; (4) set when designated representatives must be appointed; (5) provide quicker access to work permits for asylum seekers; and (6) create two exceptions to the new ineligibility provisions.
